description: A gastrointestinal disorder characterized by chronic inflammation involving all layers of the intestinal wall, noncaseating granulomas affecting the intestinal wall and regional lymph nodes, and transmural fibrosis. Crohn disease most commonly involves the terminal ileum; the colon is the second most common site of involvement.
body.label: Crohn disease

description: A Crohn disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the esophagus.
body.label: Crohn disease of the esophagus

description: A Crohn disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the ileum.
body.label: Crohn ileitis

description: A Crohn disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the anal region.
body.label: perianal Crohn disease

description: A Crohn disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the small intestine.
body.label: small bowel Crohn disease

description: An inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation located in stomach and located in duodenum, has symptom nausea, has symptom vomiting, has symptom weight loss and has symptom loss of appetite.
body.label: gastroduodenal Crohn disease

description: Any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the NOD2 gene.
body.label: inflammatory bowel disease 1

description: A Crohn disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the jejunum.
body.label: Crohn jejunitis

description: Crohn disease that occurs in non-human animals.
body.label: Crohn disease, non-human animal

description: An inflammatory bowel disease characterized by abdominal pain and watery or bloody diarrhea, with changes in the intestinal tract consistent with Crohn disease that has material basis in heterozygous mutation in the CARD8 gene on chromosome 19q13.33.
body.label: inflammatory bowel disease 30

description: A condition characterized by persistent or recurrent labial enlargement, ORAL ULCER, and other orofacial manifestations in the absence of identifiable CROHN DISEASE; or SARCOIDOSIS. Among experts there is disagreement on whether orofacial granulomatosis is a distinct clinical disorder or an initial presentation of Crohn disease.
body.label: oroficial granulomatosis

description: Ileocolitis or ileal Crohn's is the most common type of Crohn's disease. It affects both the ileum (small intestine) and the colon.
body.label: ileocolitis

description: Any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ATG16L1 gene.
body.label: inflammatory bowel disease 10

description: Any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the IRGM gene.
body.label: inflammatory bowel disease 19

description: A physiological or therapeutic change that occurs in response to mesalamine (5-aminosalicylic acid), an anti-inflammatory drug that acts locally in the gastrointestinal tract, primarily used in the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease including ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease.
body.label: response to mesalamine

description: An acute form of megacolon, severe pathological dilatation of the colon. It is associated with clinical conditions such as ulcerative colitis; crohn disease; amebic dysentery; or clostridium enterocolitis.
body.label: toxic megacolon

description: A spectrum of small and large bowel inflammatory diseases of unknown etiology. It includes Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and colitis of indeterminate type.
body.label: inflammatory bowel disease
